svg.title: PS-ISA 32-bit instruction encoding with decoded examples
svg.text: PS-ISA encoding: every instruction is one 32-bit word
imm14 (ADDI, LDG/STG offsets, S2R, LDC, SHFL)
G N P = guard: @P0, @!P2 ... (predication). Rd also names the data register of a store. aux = SETP comparison, SEL predicate, VOTE mode.
Five words from kernels/01_vector_add.psa, decoded bit by bit:
